description: This file contains a test class 'ModulesMetaCest' that performs API integration tests for the /api/v8/modules endpoints in the SuiteCRM project. It includes various test scenarios for fetching module metadata, attributes, menu configurations, view layouts, user favorites, recently viewed items, filters, and module listings, primarily using the Codeception testing framework.

classes.name: ModulesMetaCest
classes.description: A test suite class for validating the /api/v8/modules API endpoints, including metadata, attributes, menu, layout, favorites, recently viewed items, filters, and module lists in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method that initializes fake data generator and seed before each test.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetModuleMetaLanguages
methods.description: Tests retrieval of language metadata for the Accounts module.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetModuleMetaAttributes
methods.description: Tests retrieval of attribute metadata for the Accounts module.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetModuleMetaMenu
methods.description: Tests retrieval of menu metadata for the Accounts module.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetMetaLayout
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the layout metadata for the edit view of the Accounts module.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetModuleFavorites
methods.description: Tests creating an account, adding it to favorites, and retrieving the user's favorite account records.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetAllModulesFavorites
methods.description: Tests creating an account, favoriting it, and retrieving favorites across all modules.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetModuleRecentlyViewed
methods.description: Tests retrieving the recent records viewed by the current user for the Accounts module.

methods.name: TestScenarioGetAllModulesRecentlyViewed
methods.description: Tests retrieving recently viewed records for all modules.

methods.name: TestScenarioModuleFilters
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module menu filters without specific module context.

methods.name: TestScenarioModuleMenus
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module menu options.
